citations.claim: EW approach E green at step 105 just before yellow (phase EW green)
EW approach E yellow at step 106 (phase EW yellow)
EW approach E already red at step 108 in phase all-red before NS, so yellow lasted only 2s vs required 4s - first violating step

counterfactual.change: changed actuated true->false (fixed-time); same steps and all other fields identical; removes early gap-out so yellow completes full duration

explanation: With actuated=true the EW green gaps out when its own queue empties (E queue 0 at steps 105-106) while NS has demand. The controller then starts EW yellow at step 106 but truncates it to 2s, going all-red/red by step 108, instead of holding required yellow_seconds=4. Fixed-time (actuated=false) with identical timing keeps full yellow and passes, and extending run still reports same 2s yellow at step 108, so not end-of-run truncation.
vision_note: In tile 105 the active approaches show green, then in tiles 106 and 107 they show yellow for only two steps. In tile 108 all signals are red, so the yellow was cut to 2s instead of the required 4s.
